rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person or animal that is young.

example.english: Those kids are still juvenile, so don't expect them to handle everything themselves.
example.traditional: 嗰班細路年紀細，唔好要求佢哋乜都自己處理。
example.jyutping: go2 baan1 sai3 lou6 nin4 gei2 sai3 m4 hou2 jiu1 kau4 keoi5 dei6 mat1 dou1 zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that a person, thing, idea, or organism has not fully developed.

example.english: This tree is still juvenile and hasn't produced any fruit yet.
example.traditional: 呢棵樹仲未成熟，仲未生到果實。
example.jyutping: ni1 fo1 syu6 zung6 mei6 sing4 suk6 zung6 mei6 saang1 dou3 gwo2 sat6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term, especially for a legal or official minor.

example.traditional: 呢宗案件涉及一名未成年人士。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung1 on3 gin2 sip3 kap6 jat1 ming4 mei6 sing4 nin4 jan4 si6

rows.note: Use this colloquially when stressing that someone is underage for a particular activity or requirement.

example.english: A juvenile can't enter to drink alcohol.
example.traditional: 未夠秤嘅人唔可以入場飲酒。
example.jyutping: mei6 gau3 cing3 ge3 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 jap6 coeng4 jam2 zau2
